description: This file defines the implementation of the DnsConfigOverrides class, including constructors, comparison operators, and methods to create default overrides and apply them to a DnsConfig object.

classes.name: DnsConfigOverrides
classes.description: A class representing DNS configuration overrides, with methods to compare, create defaults, and apply overrides.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operators (copy and move) for DnsConfigOverrides.

methods.name: CreateOverridingEverythingWithDefaults
methods.description: Creates an override object with all settings overridden to default values.

methods.name: OverridesEverything
methods.description: Checks if all override options are set.

methods.name: ApplyOverrides
methods.description: Applies the overrides to a given DnsConfig object and returns the overridden config.
